The webview gates are listed because one file under `pulse-app/ui/` changes. The local pre-push check follows, then the operator pass.

Absences, each with its reason: - No boot-smoke entry: no file of the chunk is on the boot-smoke trigger list (test-plan §3 Per-chunk gate   discipline), and the chunk boots no app. - No headful self-verify and no `cargo xtask test:a11y` entry: no rendered surface changes. The a11y chain's one   changed link, the detector, is exercised by its pin locally and by the `a11y` job on the CI run, which the operator   pass reads. - No liveness probe and no live leg: the chunk drives no external process. - No targeted nextest entry: steps 1 and 7 run the two pin binaries as the red-before-green pair   (`cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci -E 'binary(quality_gate_workflow) + binary(a11y_perf_workflow)'`); the   workspace nextest entry runs the same tests on every re-run. - Step 7's four mutations edit a file and revert it, so each is a one-shot run at implement, both of its readings in   `evidence/mutation-checks.md`; the workspace nextest entry, which runs the five tests they prove, guards the four   properties on every re-run.

**The operator pass, in this order.** The hygiene entry, the pre-CI commit, the local pre-push entry again, the push; then the whole pull-request run of the pushed tip is read. Four reads by that run's id, as `<id>`, follow: the run's artifact names, the count of read-nothing lines across its six job logs, the a11y comparison's own line, and the perf gate's own line. The last entry lists every job, report-only. No run is re-run to obtain a green. A self-end in the boot job's series step is a new reading, brought to the operator (the handoff).
